name: Premium Mainichikoh Aqua (プレミアム毎日香 アクア)
description: Shelf review. Premium Aqua is the Mainichikoh family's clean-laundry answer: an aquatic scent with bright florals and very little smoke. It's the furthest from a temple smell in the lineup. There's no sandalwood-first profile here; it reads closer to a room fragrance you light. Verdict: pick it for a bathroom, a home office, or anyone who wants the ritual of a stick without anything that reads as religious or heavy. Traditionalists should start with the classic instead. It costs a little more than the Natural boxes for a similar bulk count. Reviewed from the maker's specs, not yet burned.
dek: Nippon Kodo · very-low-smoke stick incense · ¥1,089 bulk box · the fresh one
